name: storybabe-monorepo
description: StoryBabe - Real human experiences as text stories platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "gateway,auth,story,social,mod,worker,web" -c "blue,cyan,magenta,yellow,red,green,white" "npm run dev -w @storybabe/gateway" "npm run dev -w @storybabe/auth-service" "npm run dev -w @storybabe/story-service" "npm run dev -w @storybabe/social-service" "npm run dev -w @storybabe/moderation-service" "npm run dev -w @storybabe/worker-service" "npm run dev -w @storybabe/web"
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/types packages/security packages/database services/auth services/story services/social services/moderation services/worker apps/gateway
scripts.build:all: tsc -b packages/types packages/security packages/database services/auth services/story services/social services/moderation services/worker apps/gateway && cd apps/web && next build
